summary: Removes node a2 from a doubly linked list: unlinks prev/next pointers (links at a2+88 and a2+92), updates the list head this[10] (offset 0x28) when a2 is the head, then frees a2's trailing array allocation. The element count is read from *(a2 - 4); for a non-negative count, each element of the 96-byte-stride array is processed in reverse by EmptyStub_7470 before the whole block is freed by FreeWrapper_7bcf. Decrements the node counter this[3] (offset 0xC) and returns the new count.

operations.description: If a predecessor exists, splice forward: *(v3 + 92) = *(a2 + 92).
If a successor exists, splice backward: *(v4 + 88) = *(a2 + 88).
If a2 is the list head (this[10] == a2), promote the successor to head: this[10] = *(a2 + 92).
Load the element count prefix v5 = *(a2 - 4) and seed the reverse walk pointer v6 = a2 + 96 * v5; counter v7 = v5 - 1.
Guard on (v5 - 1) >= 0; a zero or negative count skips the element loop.
do-while over v5 elements: step the walk pointer back 96 bytes and call EmptyStub_7470 on each element in reverse order.
Free the allocation block (including the count prefix) at a2 - 4 via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Decrement the node counter: result = this[3] - 1; this[3] = result.
